confirmedDecisionInfluence.mechanism: signalLevel C is rejected after RR pass
The underlying setupQuality contributes 28% of base PriorityScore; signalLevel label itself is not the numeric score term.
Raw setupQuality is a later comparator; signalLevel label itself is not the comparator.
Allocation is score-proportional with caps; setupQuality influences priorityScore, but signalLevel label is not read by allocation formula.
compareResults sorts first by live action state, then plan.signalLevel A>B>C, then priorityScore, RR, sectorFlow, RS.
confirmedDecisionInfluence.effect: Display/processing order among monitored names with equal live action state.

noDirectUseFound.basis: evaluatePullback/evaluateMomentum/buildFinalDecision/evaluateOperationSignals use plan mode/channel, price zones, K-bars, maxChase, positionStage and risk/profit conditions; no Formal plan.signalLevel conditional found.
evaluateStop/evaluateOperationSignals use stop, sellBelow, reduceAt, price/K-volume and actual position state; no Formal signalLevel conditional found.
allocateAndBuildPlans weights selected candidates by priorityScore and max position ratio; no signalLevel term.
shouldPhonePushSignal is keyed by signal type; processSignalState operates on evaluateOperationSignals output. No Formal signalLevel push-enable condition found.

operationalNuance.notificationSequence: runBackgroundMonitor sorts results with compareResults before sequential processSignalState calls. Therefore signalLevel can affect relative notification processing/order when finalDecision action weight ties.
operationalNuance.signalExistence: No evidence found that Formal signalLevel A versus B changes whether BUY/ADD/REDUCE/SELL/STOP_LOSS conditions are satisfied after the plan exists.
operationalNuance.monitorGrade: buildMonitorStatus A/B/C is a separate live action urgency grade and must not be confused with plan.signalLevel A/B/C.

nonFormalNamespaces: Hybrid defines its own signalLevel thresholds and C rejection; do not use Hybrid semantics as evidence for Formal.
Aideen derives its own signalLevel from aideenScore; do not conflate with Formal setupQuality grade.
falsification: Any future patch adding signalLevel to evaluateOperationSignals, entry confirmation, allocation, push eligibility or position sizing invalidates this audit and requires a new version.
Monitor-order materiality is operational, not selection-alpha evidence; test only if notification/attention sequencing becomes a research question.
